title: Quarterly playbook: hosted inference runway, model-compatibility lanes, and staged rotation
creator: Jonah Park
description:
Summary:
This ticket defines the quarterly playbook for the Hosted API + Model Catalog to coordinate a predictable, low-risk model rotation cadence across tiers (stable, beta, canary) while preserving SLOs and minimizing unit cost. The playbook ties together compatibility lanes (API semantics + tokenizer/IO constraints), operational gating (perf / quality / cost), rollout stages, and cross-team responsibilities so teams can plan model additions, deprecations, and variant swaps without surprise regressions.

Goals:
- Establish a repeatable quarterly runway for selecting candidate model variants for rotation, including compatibility checks and performance baselining.
- Define staged rollout rules (internal staging -> canary -> gradual regional rollout -> full promotion) and automated rollback triggers.
- Create a small, prioritized prompt and metric suite for guardrail evals (safety, hallucination, instruction-following, latency/cost).
- Reduce the median time-to-promotion for vetted models from discovery to GA by 30% while holding P95 latency and unit cost within budget targets.

Scope (in-scope):
- Hosted API endpoints and model catalog entries only (not Dedicated or Private installs).
- Compatibility checks for API wire format, streaming behavior, function-calling conformance, and embedding dimension changes.
- Baseline perf runs (P50/P95 token latency, throughput) on representative traffic slices.
- Canary orchestration config for Console and routing policies.

Out of scope:
- New model training, large-scale model architecture changes, or infra procurement.

Key deliverables:
- Playbook doc (Confluence): runway calendar, gating checklist, rollback matrix, and SLA sign-off template.
- Canary config templates for Console and routing (JSON templates + example policy).
- Eval harness: 200-prompt guardrail set, automated quality regression report, and dashboard tile.
- Automation PRs: CI jobs for compatibility checks and perf baselines; a GitHub Actions workflow to run the guarded evals on model PRs.

Success metrics (targeted):
- Number of model rotations completed within quarter: >= 6
- Average time from candidate approval to full promotion: <= 21 days
- No more than 1 customer-facing regression per quarter attributable to model rotation
- Cost delta (tokens/1M): within +/- 10% of baseline after rotation

Rollout phases and gating criteria:
1) Internal staging: limited to internal org tokens. Pass: API conformance tests + basic latency within 1.2x baseline.
2) Canary (1% traffic, region-limited): Pass: no quality regression on guardrail set for 7 days, P95 latency within SLO, error rate < 0.1%.
3) Gradual regional rollouts (10% -> 50%): Monitor metrics and automated alerts; require ops sign-off at 50% for global promotion.
4) Full promotion: Update catalog entry and release notes; schedule deprecation for replaced variant if applicable.

Gates (must pass all):
- Compatibility checklist completed and signed by SDK/Docs owner.
- Quality score (aggregate) >= baseline - delta threshold.
- Perf budget: P95 latency and cost per token within release budget.
- Security & privacy sign-off if the model introduces new behaviors (security_review_required flag).

Risks and mitigations:
- Unexpected distribution shift in customer prompts -> mitigation: conservative canary percentages and rapid rollback hooks in router.
- Eval coverage gaps (edge prompts missing) -> mitigation: add feedback loop to capture post-canary failures and expand the guardrail suite.
- Console telemetry shortages -> mitigation: temporary increase retention for routing/trace events during rollout windows.

Acceptance criteria for Done:
- Playbook published and reviewed by Runtime, API, Console, and Observability leads.
- Canary templates merged and available in Console template library.
- Eval harness integrated into CI and passing for at least one candidate model.
- Roadmap calendar entry created and communicated to relevant GTM teams.

Notes on coordination:
- Weekly sync with ENG runtime on Thursdays; add an ops war room for the first two canaries.
- Share a pre-mortem template with SRE for every rotation that reaches canary stage.

Next steps (first 2 weeks):
- Draft playbook and circulate for review (owner: Priya)
- Ship initial guardrail set and perf baseline jobs (ENG owners)
- Template Console canary policy and confirm telemetry retention settings (Console/Observability)
